summary: Global Mofy AI Ltd filed a Form 6-K, a report of foreign private issuer, covering the period from October 1, 2025, to March 31, 2026. The filing includes unaudited interim financial statements and additional disclosures related to the company's operations in digital asset sales, virtual technology services, and equity incentive plans. No specific special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or corporate restructuring is announced. The filing is a routine periodic report that provides an update on the company's financial condition and business activities. As a foreign private issuer report, it is equivalent to a quarterly report on Form 10-Q for U.S. domestic issuers. No actionable event or transaction warranting classification as a special situation is identified; thus, the appropriate category is None. There are no deal terms to report as the filing does not contain any transaction terms.
